story_title: New Year's Eve with the Family
paragraphs: On Chinese New Year's Eve, Lina visits her grandparents with her parents. Her grandmother {{mask_1}} them that dinner was almost ready. Her grandfather {{mask_2}}, "The dumplings are on the table." Lina's mother {{mask_3}} Lina to wash her hands before eating. Lina {{mask_4}} to her cousin, "I can help you with the plates."

The family sits down for dinner. Grandma {{mask_5}} that everyone could take some fish. Grandpa {{mask_6}} the children to leave room for the vegetables. Lina's uncle {{mask_7}} to the family, "This soup is my favorite." Her aunt {{mask_8}} Lina that she had made a special dessert.

After dinner, Lina helps clear the table. Her father {{mask_9}} her to carry the small plates to the kitchen. Lina {{mask_10}}, "I will bring the cups too." Her grandmother {{mask_11}} Lina that the red envelopes were ready. Grandpa {{mask_12}} to the children, "You can open them after dinner."

The family prepares fruit and tea for their guests. Lina's aunt {{mask_13}} her where to put the tea cups. Her uncle {{mask_14}} that the guests would arrive soon. Lina {{mask_15}} to her cousin, "Let's put the oranges in this bowl." Her cousin {{mask_16}} Lina to bring more napkins.

When the guests arrive, everyone welcomes them into the living room. Grandma {{mask_17}} to the guests, "Please come in and sit down." Lina's father {{mask_18}} them that the tea was ready. Lina {{mask_19}} her younger brother to greet their relatives politely. Before the evening ended, Grandpa {{mask_20}} that he was happy the family could celebrate together.
